current_code_paired_comparison.method: Apply a 12000 s cutoff to the same deterministic trajectories generated by the 13000 s run; max_time cannot affect a trajectory before the cutoff.

historical_file_comparison.warning: Do not attribute the full five-success difference to max_time. Seeds 16, 28, and 48 succeeded before 12000 s in the current run but were timeouts in the historical file, indicating code/configuration drift since that baseline was generated.

conclusion: The 13000 s limit modestly improves this 50-seed pilot under the current code: two additional successes (+4 percentage points) and no added safety violations. The sample is too small to treat the improvement as conclusive; validate on the 300 held-out seeds if this pilot gain is operationally worthwhile.
